identity.title: Clarify Ailuros governance control boundary without platformizing the runtime

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Update canonical architecture/strategy wording so Ailuros owns governance lifecycle, policy/evidence interpretation and control decisions, while external harnesses own model/tool execution loops. Explicitly distinguish principal/workflow/invocation identity references from authentication or session state. Dependency: 8030.prove-second-producer-conformance.
human_pressure.why_now: The current repo is already the correct governance runtime, but some older wording says 'runtime orchestration' and forbids auth/sessions broadly enough that future identity/control-context work could be misunderstood. The fix is semantic precision, not code deletion.
do_not_misread: This repository is the canonical Ailuros governance runtime; do not apply cleanup assumptions from the legacy MCP Gateway repository.
Identity references are governance provenance, not login/authentication/session management.
Approval and budget in this batch are evidence-backed records/projections, not workflow/payment services.
Do not turn Ailuros into an agent executor or coding harness.
red_lines: Do not delete or refactor runtime code.
Do not add auth/session/IAM or orchestration.

machine_core.goal: Freeze the current/future governance boundary before adding new control-context evidence fields.
red_lines: Do not delete or refactor runtime code.
Do not add auth/session/IAM or orchestration.
invariants: Depends on: 8030.prove-second-producer-conformance. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Existing tool-wrap policy gate remains a valid in-process enforcement point; it is not removed.
EverRun is a proof/integration, not a core dependency.
contracts: Execution plane owns doing the work.
Ailuros owns governance facts, policy interpretation, evidence/provenance and governance decisions.
failure_semantics: Missing governance-context evidence remains unknown/absent; it is never inferred as allowed, approved, within budget or clean.
Explicit denial/violation evidence is preserved with evidence refs.
Derived control-context state remains rebuildable from immutable evidence.
Producer-native values remain preserved alongside normalized projections.

steps.title: Clarify execution versus governance lifecycle
details: Ailuros may start/complete governance runs and wrap/gate tool calls, but it does not own the model agent loop, subagents, scheduler or coding execution workflow.
Use 'governance runtime lifecycle' instead of wording that implies generic agent orchestration.

steps.title: Clarify identity references
details: Define principal_ref, workflow_ref and invocation_ref as opaque provenance/control references.
Explicitly state they do not imply user login, token issuance, tenant directory, session resumption or IAM.

steps.title: Clarify current versus future control
details: Future runtime decision APIs may consume the same contracts later, but this pack does not add a write API or live enforcement service.

steps.title: Record the ADR
details: Ailuros is governance/control plane semantics plus optional enforcement points.
EverRun/other harnesses remain execution-plane owners and independent products.

acceptance: Docs identify main-runtimegovernance as canonical Ailuros core.
Governance lifecycle is distinct from model execution workflow.
Identity refs are explicitly distinct from auth/session systems.
No code/runtime capability is added or removed.

must_check: Existing v0.3/v1.5 runtime capabilities remain described truthfully.
No legacy MCP Gateway deletion plan is imported.
reject_if: The docs say Ailuros should execute coding/model workflows.
Identity refs are redefined as authentication/login/session management.
The pack introduces live authorization APIs or platform infrastructure.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed/approved/within-budget.
